description: Enrich a project with SEO data from Haloscan (free; traffic + keyword rankings) and/or Majestic (10 credits flat; backlinks). Async — returns a job_id. Sources can be combined to get both datasets in a single job.

sources.description: Data sources. Defaults to ["haloscan"]. ["haloscan","majestic"] gives the full SEO picture (traffic + keywords + backlinks).

name: enrich_project
